thread:
jia: Quick RFC follow-up: we shipped rollout metadata; should we break opaque `pin` into `binding` + `affinity` for explicit semantics?
sam: Yes. Opaque pins cause implicit behaviour later.
matt: Splitting adds surface area; need compatibility path and schema versioning.
jia: Proposal: v1 keep `pin` string; v2 add optional `binding` and `affinity`. Resolve: binding > pin string > rollout hint.
nina: Put TTL inside `binding` and avoid raw integers surfacing ops rules.
kevin: If TTL in binding, add `ttl_policy` enum: INHERIT|SOFT|HARD so scheduler can act.
jia: Sketch: `binding:{scope,target,ttl,ttl_policy,enforcement}` `affinity:{weight,fallbacks}`.
sam: Fallbacks ok but cap to small list and deterministic order.
matt: enforcement semantics matter: REQUIRED must be guaranteed or request rejected. This implies quota checks.
nina: Suggest enforcement enum: REQUIRED|PREFERRED|OPTIONAL.
kevin: Telemetry must emit `resolved_via` (binding|pin|hint) to aid debugging.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: run `rollout-schema-check` CI.
jia: Action: I'll draft v2 schema + compatibility examples; @sam write compat table; @kevin spec quota behaviour; @matt list SDK changes. Will post RFC diff.
